tasks.title: Audit quadratic exponent block product and ring evaluation cost
tasks.task:
Work only in /home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/factoring-research. Read AGENTS.md, RESEARCH_TEAM.md, RESEARCH_LOOP.md, README.md, docs/SPECIFICATION.md. No recursive delegation, installs, commits, shared solver/Lean/STATE/registry edits. Own ONLY research/findings/W021-quadratic-product-review.md and research/findings/W021-quadratic-product-review-evidence/. Freeze this full brief and load-bearing inputs with exact read scope and hashes. Parent remains principal researcher.

New parent construction: read research/hypotheses/W021.md, focus A, B only as a scope limit. Input unit alpha mod arbitrary composite N, binary A,D,C,L. Exact product prod_i<L (1-alpha^(Ai²+Di+C)). Block i=bk+j. F(X,Y)=prod_j<b (1-alpha^(Aj²+Dj) X^j Y); evaluate at Xk=alpha^(2Abk), Yk=alpha^(Ab²k²+Dbk+C). Dense F has degrees b²/2,b hence O(b³) coefficients, built by degree-aware balanced multiplication in O~b³ ring work. After full multiplication, relabel X exponent e as two base-b digits, evaluate 3-var polynomial at (Xk,Xk^b,Yk), all individual degrees <=b. Proposed use Kedlaya-Umans nearly linear multivariate evaluation over Z/NZ gives (b³+L/b)^(1+epsilon) poly(binary widths), b~L1/4 => L^(3/4+epsilon). No claimed field-only ring-operation bound; the intended tool is nonalgebraic bit complexity over composite rings. Repeated points, zeros, no root/order/factor oracle. Shifted intervals only change C,D; balanced product localization uses geometric sum of cost. At most2 integer zeros of nonzero f can be removed with paid exact quadratic arithmetic, but coverage after removal remains external; f identically0 rejected.

Audit exact algebra, density/degree accounting and actual balanced product construction; exact binary exponent costs including negative coefficients and huge input widths; split exponent relabelling is NOT a ring homomorphism during construction. Audit original theorem and Turing-machine bit model, arbitrary N versus fields, uniformity, constants, degree digit splitting. Primary leads: https://users.cms.caltech.edu/~umans/papers/KU08-final.pdf Cor4.3; https://www.texmacs.org/joris/kucomp/kucomp.pdf introduction plus actual Turing-machine bound. Parent only read latter's intro statements. Do a focused primary prior-art search for product of quadratic/polynomial exponential sequences; no novelty claim. Is proposed sublinear supplied-product bound valid and already known? Give equal-input comparator and precise scope.

Completed W020-collision-extraction-review.md accepts ANY finite covered family with every nonzero integer exponent and paid nonunit localization; full collision yields annihilator of original uniform alpha and <=2 expected trials via pointwise local-valuation failure inclusion. It removes high-order and all-global-tag recovery requirements; do not reinstate them. It supplies NO coverage or product algorithm. Read only as needed. W021 explicitly does NOT compute W019 arbitrary modular root/carry table and does NOT yield new factoring exponent; squared weights lose occurrence density even granting centered intervals. C is under separate bounded validation; do not duplicate.

Optional one preregistered frozen certificate <=60sec/20000 charged events, freeze cases and code before executing once. Compare exact block identity, digit relabelling, shifts, incomplete tail, signed powers, composite/repeated-point values against direct products. A toy certificate does not implement KU or establish asymptotics. Retain all failures, no tuning or sweeps. Deliver accepted/repaired/rejected primitive and actual remaining factoring acquisition/coverage questions.

tasks.title: Falsify cyclic folding of Frobenius coefficient support
tasks.task:
Work only in /home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/factoring-research. Read AGENTS.md, RESEARCH_TEAM.md, RESEARCH_LOOP.md, README.md, docs/SPECIFICATION.md. No recursive delegation, installs, commits, shared solver/Lean/STATE/registry edits. Own ONLY research/findings/W021-frobenius-support-review.md and research/findings/W021-frobenius-support-review-evidence/. Freeze this full brief and load-bearing input/read scope/hashes. Main parent continues construction.

Read research/hypotheses/W021.md section C (A has separate Opus review, do not duplicate). Different factoring starting point: for odd distinct p<q,N=pq, (1+X)^N modp=(1+X^p)^q; the first positive binomial coefficient not divisibleN is atdegreep, with gcd(binomial(N,p),N)=q. Proposed concrete compressed selector: compute (1+X)^N modulo (N,X^r-1) for a fixed short public r menu by binary polynomial powering, inspect individual coefficient gcds both before and after subtracting1+X^N. Goal is NOT an asserted gain: folding mixes support, p invertible modr spreads its multiples across all residue classes. Determine exact relation to Fermat/Lucas/cyclotomic tests and whether any justified factor advantage remains. Symbolic lead r2: raw even/odd coefficient2^(N-1), corrected coefficients2^(N-1)-1, so this is the ordinary base2 Fermat-gcd filter. For gcd(p,r)=1, Frobenius permutation means corrected polynomial vanishes modp iff (1+X)^q=1+X^q mod(p,X^r-1); checking individual coefficients is weaker. Prove/repair these and avoid unsupported random coefficient assumptions.

One OPTIONAL but useful fixed certificate <=60sec/20000 charged arithmetic events, freeze code/cases/protocol before single execution, retain all failed/unstarted cases. Suggested exact cases N=15,35,77,143,221,437 and r=2,3,5,7; distinguish r-sharing-factor controls from coprime-r cases, include plain gcd(N,r) baseline and base2 Fermat-gcd baseline. Output all raw/corrected coefficient gcd vectors, exact costs, any factors only verifier-confirmed. You may shrink the preregistered suite before freezing to satisfy cap, never after observing results. Charge actual convolution coefficient multiply-adds as events, plus modular exponent/gcd/input work, state cost-accounting limits. No success-rate/asymptotic extrapolation. Prefer symbolic counterexample if decisive. Primary prior-art only with exact read scope; no claim that all polynomial congruence methods fail. Deliver exact failed assumption and one materially different computational change that could preserve the useful support, not a renamed coefficient oracle.
